note: Proposed day-to-lesson mapping from verified README roadmap and existing curriculum. Candidate days are not verified exact sections. Do not publish citations/assets until reviewed and licensed. No images downloaded.

phases.title: AI Engineer kasbi va individual yo‘l
phases.miniProject: Kasbiy yo‘nalish tanlovi va shaxsiy yo‘l xaritasi
phases.visualLab: AI ilovasi tarkibiy qismlari (UI → Backend → Model → Natija) vizual xaritasi
phases.supplementNote: AGI, kasbiy rollar va ta'lim yo'li tafsilotlarini kerak bo'lsa alohida tekshirish.

lessons.title: AI Engineer va ML Engineer farqi
AI, ML, Deep Learning va Generative AI o‘rtasidagi aloqa
LLM, RAG, Agent, Vector DB bir-biriga qanday ulanadi?

phases.title: Python / TypeScript dasturlash poydevori
phases.miniProject: JSON faylini o‘qib, tekshiradigan va natijani yozadigan CLI
phases.visualLab: Kodning ishlash oqimi: input → function → output; async event timeline
phases.supplementNote: Python Academy / TypeScript poydevori; repo Day 0 faqat boshlang‘ich yo‘naltiruvchi manba.

phases.title: Backend, API, Git va ma’lumotlar bazasi
phases.miniProject: FastAPI da validatsiyali kichik REST servis
phases.visualLab: Interaktiv HTTP request lifecycle va status code xaritasi
phases.supplementNote: SQL, Git va backend asoslari uchun alohida manba; Day 6/14 faqat integratsiya konteksti.

phases.title: AI va LLM qanday ishlaydi?
phases.originalSource: 1. Introduction; 3. Pre-trained Models & Working with LLMs
phases.miniProject: Tokenization va context hajmini ko‘rsatadigan vizual mini-ilova
phases.visualLab: Token → ID → embedding → output oqimi va training/inference ikki yo‘lakli animatsiya
phases.supplementNote: Training, gradient, backpropagation, transformer turlari bo'yicha qamrovni tekshirish.

lessons.title: Token va so‘z bir xil emas

phases.title: Tayyor modellar, model tanlash va ekotizim
phases.miniProject: 3 vazifa uchun model tanlash jadvali va asoslantirish
phases.visualLab: Model tanlash qaror daraxti; sifat–xarajat–latency trade-off slayderlari (faqat illustrativ)
phases.supplementNote: Open-weight oilalari, maxfiylik va model versiyalari bo‘yicha alohida rasmiy manbalar.

lessons.title: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Cohere — xizmat sifatida model
Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemma, Qwen — model oilalari
Benchmark va o‘z test dataseti farqi

phases.title: LLM API, SDK va lokal bo‘lmagan inference
phases.miniProject: Bir nechta provayderni almashtira oladigan xavfsiz backend endpoint
phases.visualLab: Request lifecycle va streaming token oqimi
phases.supplementNote: Hugging Face va providerlar uchun rasmiy docs tekshirilsin.

phases.title: Prompt Engineering asoslari
phases.miniProject: Uch uslubdagi prompt uchun regression test to‘plami
phases.visualLab: Bir xil modelga turli promptlarning javob formatini solishtirish (real API yoki oldindan belgilangan namuna)
phases.supplementNote: Repo bo‘limlari bilan aniq moslikni tekshirish.

lessons.title: CoT prompting konsepti (shaxsiy reasoningni talab qilmasdan)

phases.title: Inference parametrlari, Structured Output, Tools
phases.miniProject: Schema-validatsiyali JSON generator va bitta calculator tool
phases.visualLab: Sampling distribution slayderi va tool-call state diagrammasi
phases.supplementNote: Top-k, repetition penalty, prompt caching qamrovi provayderga qarab tekshirilsin.

phases.title: Context Engineering va xotira
phases.miniProject: Cheklangan context uchun xavfsiz tarix qisqartirish prototipi
phases.visualLab: Context window uchun token budjeti vizual bar; history compaction steps
phases.supplementNote: Compaction, isolation va state uchun qo‘shimcha tekshiruv.

phases.title: AI Safety, Ethics va Privacy
phases.miniProject: Ruxsatsiz tool action’ni bloklaydigan agent guardrail testi
phases.visualLab: Trust boundary oqimi va prompt injection xavfsiz demonstratsiyasi
phases.supplementNote: Repo bo‘limlari bilan aniq moslikni tekshirish.

lessons.title: Human-in-the-loop va muhim operatsiyalar uchun ruxsat

phases.title: Open-weight modellar va lokal inference
phases.miniProject: Ollama API bilan lokal oddiy chatbot (imkon bo‘lsa)
phases.visualLab: Model → quantization → memory grafiklari; prefill/decode animatsiyasi
phases.supplementNote: Repo roadmapida lokal inference, GGUF, CUDA/MPS/TPU uchun alohida kun yo‘q; rasmiy hujjatlar zarur.

phases.title: Embeddings va vektor matematikasi
phases.miniProject: Oddiy 3 ta gap uchun embedding qidiruvi (model bo‘lmasa sonli demo deb belgilansin)
phases.visualLab: 2D vektor chizish, dot product va cosine similarity real hisoblash
phases.supplementNote: Vektor matematikasining formulalari tekshirilsin; 2D projection real embedding deb berilmasin.

phases.title: Vector Database va ANN Search
phases.miniProject: Qdrant yoki Chroma bilan indekslash va qidirish API
phases.visualLab: Vektor fazosida query, nearest neighbors va top-k highlight
phases.supplementNote: Qdrant/Chroma/FAISS rasmiy hujjatlari kerak bo‘lishi mumkin.

phases.title: RAG: hujjat tayyorlash va indexing
phases.miniProject: Bir kichik Markdown hujjatni chunk va index qilish
phases.visualLab: Document → chunks → embedding → VDB interaktiv animatsiya
phases.supplementNote: Parsing formatlari va incremental update alohida tekshirilsin.

phases.title: RAG: retrieval, generation, citation
phases.miniProject: Manbali savol-javob API, topilgan hujjatni ko‘rsatish
phases.visualLab: Query → top-k chunks → context → answer; source highlight
phases.supplementNote: Repo bo‘limlari bilan aniq moslikni tekshirish.

phases.title: RAG sifatini tekshirish va optimallashtirish
phases.miniProject: 10+ tekshiruv savolli RAG evaluation hisobot
phases.visualLab: Retrieval natijalari va manbalarga moslik interaktiv tekshiruvi
phases.supplementNote: Hit@k, MRR va boshqa metrikalar ta’riflarini rasmiy manbalardan tasdiqlash.

phases.title: AI Agents, Tools va workflow
phases.miniProject: 2 ta tool bilan boshqariladigan agent, failure va approval ssenariylari
phases.visualLab: Agent state machine: plan/act/observe/stop; step-through tool calls
phases.supplementNote: Repo bo‘limlari bilan aniq moslikni tekshirish.

phases.title: MCP va agentlarni kengaytirish
phases.miniProject: Bitta xavfsiz read-only MCP tool bilan integratsiya
phases.visualLab: MCP Host → Client → Server → Tool request animatsiyasi
phases.supplementNote: MCP transport va auth uchun amaldagi MCP specification tekshirilsin.

lessons.title: Agent va tashqi tizim audit log

phases.title: Evaluation, Observability va Production
phases.miniProject: Kichik production AI servis uchun log/eval dashboard va testlar
phases.visualLab: Request trace timeline, latency va cost breakdown (faqat real metrikalar)
phases.supplementNote: p50/p95, log redaction, tracing vendor docs bilan tekshirilsin.

phases.title: Multimodal AI va yakuniy amaliy loyiha
phases.originalSource: 10. Multimodal AI; Xaritani Amaliy O‘zlashtirish Tartibi
phases.miniProject: RAG + Tool Agent + Evaluation + (ixtiyoriy) Vision/STT/TTS yakuniy loyiha
phases.visualLab: Image/audio/text → model → result; modality routing oqimi
phases.supplementNote: Multimodal AI uchun alohida kun roadmapda ko‘rsatilmagan; 20.01–20.13 uchun qo‘shimcha rasmiy manbalar, 20.14–20.17 uchun Day 30.
